001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007@HistoryLogProps(
008    opCode = 64,
009    displayName = "Bolus Requested 1/3",
010    internalName = "LID_BOLUS_REQUESTED_MSG1",
011    usedByAndroid = true,
012    usedByTidepool = true
013)
014public class BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
015    
016    private int bolusId;
017    private int bolusTypeId;
018    private boolean correctionBolusIncluded;
019    private int carbAmount;
020    private int bg;
021    private float iob;
022    private long carbRatio;
023    
024    public BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog() {}
025    
026    public BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int bolusTypeId, boolean correctionBolusIncluded, int carbAmount, int bg, float iob, long carbRatio) {
027        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, bolusTypeId, correctionBolusIncluded, carbAmount, bg, iob, carbRatio, 0);
028    }
029
030    public BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int bolusTypeId, boolean correctionBolusIncluded, int carbAmount, int bg, float iob, long carbRatio, int headerHighNibble) {
031        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
032        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, bolusTypeId, correctionBolusIncluded, carbAmount, bg, iob, carbRatio, headerHighNibble);
033        this.bolusId = bolusId;
034        this.bolusTypeId = bolusTypeId;
035        this.correctionBolusIncluded = correctionBolusIncluded;
036        this.carbAmount = carbAmount;
037        this.bg = bg;
038        this.iob = iob;
039        this.carbRatio = carbRatio;
040        
041    }
042
043    public int typeId() {
044        return 64;
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * <table border="1">
049     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog:</caption>
050     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
051     * <tr><td><code>bolusTypeId</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
052     * <tr><td><code>correctionBolusIncluded</code></td><td><code>raw[13] != 0</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>carbAmount</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>bg</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>iob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>carbRatio</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
057     * </table>
058     */
059    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
060        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
061        this.cargo = raw;
062        parseBase(raw);
063        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
064        this.bolusTypeId = raw[12];
065        this.correctionBolusIncluded = raw[13] != 0;
066        this.carbAmount = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
067        this.bg = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
068        this.iob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
069        this.carbRatio = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
070        
071    }
072
073    
074    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int bolusType, boolean correctionBolusIncluded, int carbAmount, int bg, float iob, long carbRatio) {
075        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, bolusType, correctionBolusIncluded, carbAmount, bg, iob, carbRatio, 0);
076    }
077
078    /**
079     * <table border="1">
080     * <caption>Byte layout for BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog.buildCargo(...):</caption>
081     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
082     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
083     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
084     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
085     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
086     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
087     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
088     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
089     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
090     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
091     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
092     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>(byte) bolusType</code></td></tr>
093     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>(byte) (correctionBolusIncluded ? 1 : 0)</code></td></tr>
094     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(carbAmount) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
095     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(carbAmount) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
096     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bg) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
097     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bg) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
098     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
099     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
100     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
101     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
102     * <tr><td>20</td><td><code>toUint32(carbRatio) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
103     * <tr><td>21</td><td><code>toUint32(carbRatio) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
104     * <tr><td>22</td><td><code>toUint32(carbRatio) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
105     * <tr><td>23</td><td><code>toUint32(carbRatio) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
106     * </table>
107     */
108    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int bolusType, boolean correctionBolusIncluded, int carbAmount, int bg, float iob, long carbRatio, int headerHighNibble) {
109        return Bytes.combine(
110            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(64, headerHighNibble),
111            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
112            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
113            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId), 
114            new byte[]{ (byte) bolusType }, 
115            new byte[]{ (byte) (correctionBolusIncluded ? 1 : 0) }, 
116            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(carbAmount), 
117            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bg), 
118            Bytes.toFloat(iob), 
119            Bytes.toUint32(carbRatio));
120    }
121
122    /**
123     * @return the ID of the bolus operation
124     */
125    public int getBolusId() {
126        return bolusId;
127    }
128
129    public int getBolusTypeId() {
130        return bolusTypeId;
131    }
132
133    /**
134     * @return how the bolus was requested, or null if the raw value is not recognized.
135     *
136     * <p>Treated as a scalar enum rather than the bitmask used by
137     * {@link BolusDeliveryHistoryLog#getBolusTypes()}. <b>Validated against a 48k-record real-pump
138     * capture:</b> cross-correlating this field with the bolus's delivery source (as reported by
139     * {@link BolusDeliveryHistoryLog.BolusSource}) by bolus ID showed 0 ({@code INSULIN}) agreeing
140     * with {@code QUICK_BOLUS} on 25/25 boluses and 3 ({@code REMOTE}) agreeing with
141     * {@code BLUETOOTH_REMOTE_BOLUS} on 118/118 boluses. Raw values 1 ({@code CARB}) and 2
142     * ({@code AUTOMATIC_CORRECTION}) were not observed in the capture and remain unverified.
143     */
144    public BolusType getBolusType() {
145        return BolusType.fromId(bolusTypeId);
146    }
147
148    /**
149     * The way in which a bolus was requested, as reported by this log only.
150     *
151     * <p>Value names ported from tconnectsync and not independently verified here; see
152     * {@link #getBolusType()}.
153     *
154     * <p>Deliberately distinct from {@link BolusDeliveryHistoryLog.BolusType}, which is a bitmask
155     * of the components making up a bolus and is a different field with a different encoding.
156     */
157    public enum BolusType {
158        INSULIN(0),
159        CARB(1),
160        AUTOMATIC_CORRECTION(2),
161        REMOTE(3),
162        ;
163
164        private final int id;
165        BolusType(int id) {
166            this.id = id;
167        }
168
169        public int id() {
170            return id;
171        }
172
173        public static BolusType fromId(int id) {
174            for (BolusType b : values()) {
175                if (b.id() == id) {
176                    return b;
177                }
178            }
179            return null;
180        }
181    }
182
183    /**
184     * @return if the correction bolus is included
185     */
186    public boolean getCorrectionBolusIncluded() {
187        return correctionBolusIncluded;
188    }
189
190    /**
191     * @return carbs in grams.
192     *
193     * <p>The ordering of this field (offset 14) and {@link #getBg()} (offset 16) was validated
194     * against a 48k-record real-pump capture: offset 14 held carb-gram values, while offset 16
195     * held plausible BG values in mg/dL across 143/143 correlated records.
196     */
197    public int getCarbAmount() {
198        return carbAmount;
199    }
200
201    /**
202     * @return BG in mg/dL (offset 16). See the note on {@link #getCarbAmount()}; this ordering was
203     * validated against a 48k-record real-pump capture.
204     */
205    public int getBg() {
206        return bg;
207    }
208
209    /**
210     * @return current insulin on board.
211     *
212     * <p>The analysis attached to the linked issue reports this field reading zero on records
213     * whose corresponding {@link BolusActivatedHistoryLog} and {@link BolusCompletedHistoryLog}
214     * carry a nonzero IOB, and recommends preferring those logs as the source of IOB. Not
215     * reproduced here; the records committed to this repository carry a nonzero value.
216     */
217    public float getIob() {
218        return iob;
219    }
220
221    /**
222     * @return carb ratio from the insulin delivery profile, in thousandths of a gram per unit
223     */
224    public long getCarbRatio() {
225        return carbRatio;
226    }
227
228    /**
229     * @return carb ratio from the insulin delivery profile, in grams per unit
230     */
231    public double getCarbRatioGramsPerUnit() {
232        return carbRatio / 1000.0;
233    }
234}
